description: cowfootR is an R package for estimating dairy-farm greenhouse-gas emissions from herd, manure, soil-nitrogen, energy and purchased-input records. Its developers implement IPCC and International Dairy Federation accounting methods, with batch comparisons and emissions per milk output or land area. The JOSS paper describes annual farm-level results; spatial coverage is the farms supplied, and temporal resolution is yearly. The public R DESCRIPTION states MIT, so the code is free. Food-supply modellers could use its consistent emissions estimates to parameterize dairy-production scenarios or compare a regional pathway. A caveat is that the calculator is an accounting workflow, not a dynamic herd or supply-chain simulator. Default emission factors, incomplete farm data and system-boundary choices affect results. Annual totals can hide seasonal peaks and interactions with feed markets. No directly related catalogue record was found. The article and own repository metadata were read without obtaining farm records or computing emissions.
name: cowfootR dairy farm emissions accounting
